subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split so the heartbeat wake precedence bug is fixed first, while Telegram's documented default DM-to-main behavior stays under a separate product decision?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete source-backed bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from the documented `session.dmScope: main` default would affect existing users who rely on main-session continuity.

options.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
options.body: Fix explicit `heartbeat.session` precedence and event migration/restore behavior now, and leave Telegram DM default isolation to a separate docs-backed product decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram Isolation
options.body: Change Telegram private DMs to isolate by default as part of this issue, accepting upgrade, docs, and migration review for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer To Native Heartbeat Entries
options.body: Wait for a broader per-session heartbeat scheduling design, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
recommendation.body: Fix explicit `heartbeat.session` precedence and event migration/restore behavior now, and leave Telegram DM default isolation to a separate docs-backed product decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest recent history across heartbeat, routing, exec-session, and compatibility-sensitive session behavior among the sampled files.
